title_zh: 全国总工会原副主席张世平被开除党籍
title_en: Former Vice Chairman of All-China Federation of Trade Unions Zhang Shiping Expelled from Party
summary_zh: 2026年7月27日，全国总工会原副主席张世平因安排亲属不实际工作而获取薪酬等违纪问题被开除党籍。
summary_en: On July 27, 2026, former Vice Chairman of All-China Federation of Trade Unions Zhang Shiping was expelled from the Party for arranging relatives to receive salaries without actual work.
